summary: Eni S.p.A. filed a Form 6-K reporting the purchase of 875,813 treasury shares (0.03% of share capital) on 8 May 2026 on Euronext Milan at an average price of €22.8359 per share, total consideration ~€20 million. This is the first tranche of a share buyback program approved by shareholders on 6 May 2026 to serve the 2026-2028 Long-Term Incentive Plan. Post-purchase, Eni holds 87,703,920 treasury shares (2.90% of capital). The filing discloses hourly transaction details. This routine open-market repurchase under an authorized program is a capital return to shareholders. Watch for future tranches and impact on EPS.
